title: InteropAtlas Base Object
description: Base schema using English machine identifiers with bilingual Chinese/English knowledge fields.

name_en.description: English human-readable name or official English name where applicable.

official_name.description: Official source-language name when it should be preserved separately from translated display names.

record_created_at.description: Timestamp when this InteropAtlas canonical record was first created. This is repository-record lifecycle metadata, not the real-world entity/artifact creation or publication time. Prefer RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 with an explicit timezone.

record_updated_at.description: Timestamp of the latest substantive update to this InteropAtlas canonical record. This is repository-record lifecycle metadata; Git history remains the authoritative event log. Prefer RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 with an explicit timezone.

last_verified_at.description: Timestamp of the latest substantive verification of this record against its cited source/evidence. Verification may occur without changing record_updated_at. Prefer RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 with an explicit timezone.

last_verified_by.description: Stable Human or Agent identity that performed the latest substantive verification. This is verification provenance, not the GitHub Actor.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag when known, for example en or zh-CN.
